text: 在今年的虹桥国际论坛上，美中贸易全国委员会会长谭森接受了总台记者的采访。他表示，美国企业不希望看到贸易保护主义抬头。 美中贸易全国委员会会长谭森：我们喜欢贸易摩擦吗？当然不。我们喜欢关税吗？肯定也不。我们每年都会调研美国企业，问他们中国在自身全球战略、全球竞争力当中有多重要。你猜美国企业眼中中国在其全球战略里的重要性如何？结果是持续上升。双方合作不仅是在持续，而且统计数据显示合作规模在上升。这意味着我们的企业和中国企业总会找到方式对接、合作，因为合作会让双方变得更强。（央视新闻）
text_en: At this year's Hongqiao International Forum, Craig Allen, President of the US-China Business Council, accepted an interview with a CCTV reporter. He said that American companies do not want to see a rise in trade protectionism. Craig Allen, President of the US-China Business Council: Do we like trade friction? Of course not. Do we like tariffs? Definitely not. Every year we survey American companies and ask them how important China is in their own global strategy and global competitiveness. Guess how important American companies see China as being in their global strategy? The result is that it keeps rising. Not only is cooperation between the two sides continuing, but statistics show that the scale of cooperation is increasing. This means that our companies and Chinese companies will always find ways to connect and cooperate, because cooperation makes both sides stronger. (CCTV News)
